convert_aura_flow_weights: convert an original AuraFlow state dict to the diffusers format using convert_transformer
load_aura_flow_state_dict: load the original AuraFlow PyTorch model weights from a Hugging Face hub repo
calculate_dit_layers: calculate the number of double or single DiT layers from a state dict key list
swap_scale_shift_weights: swap the scale and shift chunks of a normalization layer weight tensor
populate_aura_flow_model: download original weights, convert them, and load into an AuraFlowTransformer2DModel
